notes.title: Unique Item in Poop + Hamster Combat Beta

Hamster combat will be released at [b]11 Jule 2024 8:00 PM GTM+3[/b]. On release we will be giving everyone [b]unique item[/b] for just logging in a game, this offer will be available for [b]only 1 day after release[/b]!

notes.title: Poop fixes and your art work
notes.content:
[h2][b]Fixes:[/b][/h2]
Today we fixed issues with item drops, including DLC chests drop, for receiving this fix you need to update the game.  We also added a time limited 1 extra DLC chest drop as compensation, which will be available only for 1 day for all DLC owners by simply starting the game. Now you can receive drops just by starting the game every 3 hours for common and dlc chest and every 18 hours for rare chest.

[h2][b]Your Artwork suggestions:[/b][/h2]
We also want to let you know that we are planning to replace the current free common and rare chest with new chest with new items at jule 11, so those chests will be removed from drop pool and new ones will be added instead. If you have any suggestions for new items we created a text channel called "your-art-suggestions", where you can post your poop arts for new chest, if we liked any of those and decide to add it in game we will credit your nickname and give you some rewards. You can also post any suggestions about making our game better in "your-suggestions" text channel.

[h3][b]Click to join discord and share your poop arts![/b][/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/7srK8wsT][img]https://i.postimg.cc/hj7d1NC6/discord-button.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: DLC with Rare Drop + Weekend Unique Drop + Time Limited Item Store
notes.content:
[h3]DLC[/h3]
We are happy to announce that we have released our DLC with unique Rare Drop!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3087510/Poop__Epic_Poop/
By buying DLC you will instantly get:
[list]
[*] 3 keys for locked chests, each of them cost 0.25$ if you buy them separately
[*] 1 DLC chest
[*] Access to DLC chest drop for playtime, every 3 hours you will get 1 DLC chest
[/list]

[h3]DLC Discount[/h3]
For [b]2 weeks[/b] you will be able to buy [b]DLC[/b] with [b]40% discount[/b], so do not miss your chance to increase your loot, unlock new great items and increase your collection!

[h3]New 3 days only drop[/h3]

We are also [b]stop dropping our release day unique Big Green Poop[/b] item and adding new time limited unique item for first weekend! [b]For 3 days only you will be able to get special Demon Bloody Poop[/b] just for opening game!

[h3]New shop items available only for week[/h3]
In addition, we start selling time-limited unique poops in our item store, first two of them:
[list]
[*] Poop with sauce

[/list]
They will be available for buying for [b]week only[/b]!

notes.title: Poop is released with limited item drop at beginning!
notes.content:
We are glad to say that we finally released poop! You finally can build your own collection of more than 20 poops with different tier. Click is optional you will get welcome chest drop when you first enter the game and each 3 hours you will get another common chest, and rare chest every 18 hours. Also with some probability you may get a locked chest  and open it with a treasure key. And for the end of the announcement we prepared for you unique green item that will be dropped for everyone in first 24 hours after release! Have a good drop!
